python -c "
import parse
from decimal import Decimal

# Test R4 - Microseconds with various digit counts
print('[R4] Testing microseconds:')
p = parse.compile('{ti}')
test_cases = [
    '2023-01-15 10:30:45.1',
    '2023-01-15 10:30:45.12',
    '2023-01-15 10:30:45.123',
    '2023-01-15 10:30:45.1234',
    '2023-01-15 10:30:45.12345',
    '2023-01-15 10:30:45.123456',
]
for ts in test_cases:
    r = p.parse(ts)
    if r is None:
        print(f'  FAILED: {ts}')
    else:
        print(f'  OK: {ts} -> ti={r.named[\"ti\"]}')
"
